purpose: Machine-readable routing and protocol fixtures for waa-agent-delegation.

cases.prompt: Rename one local variable in a five-line function. Do the work directly.
expected_conditions: Do not invoke the delegation Skill
Do not create a Subagent
forbidden_conditions: Delegate to demonstrate multi-agent behavior

expected_conditions: Discuss the decision directly
forbidden_conditions: Construct an immediate task packet

cases.prompt: Create a permanent architecture Agent personality.

specialist_contract contains all eight numbered sections

expected_conditions: assembly_type is NAMED_AGENT

expected_conditions: Reject normal reception

forbidden_conditions: Silently transfer ownership
Create joint ownership

cases.prompt: Return a partially completed task with one required verification still unperformed.
expected_conditions: Use PARTIAL
Disclose completed work, unfinished work, impact, evidence, unknowns, and next handoff
forbidden_conditions: Use DONE

cases.prompt: A critical task input is missing before execution.
expected_conditions: First task-status line is BLOCKED
forbidden_conditions: Use a capability or delivery status

cases.prompt: A browser is available, but the packet authorizes read-only local investigation only.

cases.prompt: A required sandbox approval is denied before delegated execution.

Infer full behavior from Codex or Claude Code
